report.title: Describe the situation
report.intro: Type or speak in English or Urdu. The AI fills in the form below, and you check it before anything is sent.
report.label: Your report
report.placeholder: e.g. About 40 houses near Dadu are flooded. We need water and medicine.
report.statusUploading: Uploading your recording and analysing it...
report.statusWaking: Starting the AI assistant. This may take up to a minute.
report.statusDone: Done. Please check the form below.
mic.unsupported: Recording is not supported in this browser. Type your report instead.
mic.blocked: Microphone is blocked. Type your report instead.
mic.silent: We could not hear anything. Please record again or type your report.
confirm.title: Check the details, then confirm
confirm.body: The AI can make mistakes. Edit anything below. Nothing is saved until you press "{button}".
confirm.pin: Place a pin on the map. The AI cannot know the exact location.
confirm.estimate: The number of people ({n}) is an estimate. Please correct it if you know better.
confirm.noQty: {item} was mentioned but no amount was given. Enter a quantity.
assistant.title: Ask Karwan
assistant.intro: Answers come from live requests, stock, allocations and deliveries. The assistant explains; it cannot change anything.
assistant.emptyHint: No questions yet. Try one of these:
assistant.label: Your question
assistant.placeholder: e.g. Why did Badin receive less water?
assistant.looking: Looking at the live Karwan data...
assistant.outOfScope: Outside what I can help with
assistant.fallbackError: The assistant is unavailable right now.
assistant.transcribeError: We could not understand that recording. Please type your question.
assistant.suggest1: Why did Badin receive less water?
assistant.suggest3: Which depot has the most medicine?
assistant.suggest4: Why is one request ranked above another?
error.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are missing or invalid. Please check your input.
error.UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO: We could not use that recording. Please record again or type instead.
error.AUDIO_TOO_LARGE: The recording is too long or too large. Keep it under 30 seconds or type instead.
error.AI_TIMEOUT: The AI assistant is busy. You can continue with the manual form.
error.AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The AI assistant has reached its limit for now. You can continue with the manual form.
error.AI_INVALID_OUTPUT: The AI could not understand that. Please edit your text or use the manual form.
error.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI assistant is unavailable. You can continue with the manual form.
error.KARWAN_API_UNAVAILABLE: Karwan data is unavailable right now. Please try again shortly.
